description: This file contains the implementation of a mock plugin store for testing purposes in the Focalboard server, including user, team, channel, and license management functions.

classes.name: PluginTestStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of a plugin store for testing, with predefined users, teams, and license management.

methods.name: GetTeam
methods.description: Retrieves a team by ID, returning predefined team objects or an error.

methods.name: GetTeamsForUser
methods.description: Returns the list of teams associated with a user based on user ID.

methods.name: GetUserByID
methods.description: Fetches a user by ID from the predefined user map.

methods.name: GetUsersList
methods.description: Returns a list of users based on provided user IDs.

methods.name: GetUserByEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by email from the predefined user map.

methods.name: GetUserByUsername
methods.description: Finds a user by username from the predefined user map.

methods.name: GetUserPreferences
methods.description: Returns user preferences for a specific user ID.

methods.name: GetUsersByTeam
methods.description: Returns users associated with a specific team, with special handling for guest IDs.

methods.name: SearchUsersByTeam
methods.description: Searches for users within a team matching a search query.

methods.name: CanSeeUser
methods.description: Determines if one user can see another based on guest status and shared board memberships.

methods.name: SearchUserChannels
methods.description: Returns a list of channels for a user in a team.

methods.name: GetChannel
methods.description: Retrieves a channel by ID, returning predefined channels or an error.

methods.name: SearchBoardsForUser
methods.description: Searches for boards accessible to a user, filtering by team membership.

methods.name: GetLicense
methods.description: Returns a license object, creating a default one if none exists, with optional compliance feature based on environment variable.
